notes.title: Development Update - The path ahead
notes.content:
[u][b][i]Hi there, Chilman here![/i][/b][/u]
Wanted to bring a small update on the plans for the future.
As you probably know, the game is still in a very early stage and there will be a lot of work ahead to reach the final shape that we want for Omnimancer, and for that nothing will be more important than time.

[b][i]How the game started[/i][/b]
What I imagine not a lot of people will know is that this game was originally developed as a final project for college, it was the final step in getting a degree, and gladly it was very well received and got an above passing grade, the build that was submitted was the First Official Build - Early Access 2.0 and while we had our regrets about things we wish we had not wasted time on or decisions that were not ideal we are still glad that we got to a state that was able to show most of the core of what this game can become.

[b][i]What we want[/i][/b]
We have lots of ideas of what features we would like to see on the completed game, so to give you something to wait for here are some of them:
[b][i][list]
[*] Boss fights
[*] Permanent progression system
[*] NPCs + Storyline
[*] Spell combinations
[/list][/i][/b]
We will share more specifics on how we want to implement these and other features, but they are a few of the things that either the game needs to have as a roguelike or that we want to be part of the game's identity.

[b][i]Community[/i][/b]
We have not put the needed time into preparing a space for the community yet, but we are working on it. For now you can access the [url=https://discord.gg/qp22wTPh43]Discord[/url] server and chat with us or between yourselves, even if it hasn't been finished yet. 

[b][i]Development ahead[/i][/b]
Lastly, lets talk about what's coming immediately
Right before this post you might have seen an update was pushed, with some changes. As for the next update, things are going to be a bit different. Since the game was being developed under a time crunch, certain shortcuts were taken, both in design and implementation, in order to reach an mvp for our college presentation. Because of this, there are many things that are either partially or completely detrimental to the continued development of the game and the new features to come. So, instead of continuing to build upon this unstable foundation and eventually have to deal with multiple points of failure we are now going to take the time to revise the game, mainly in implementation but also in design, so that we can have a stronger foundation for the future. This will result in the next update to be less noticeable for you the player, since we want to keep the experience mostly the same, but in the background there will be changes in place to allow us to expand the game to much more than it's current state.

Please reach us with any feedback, we appreciate you.
Thank you for checking out this wall of text

notes.title: Update 1 - Early Access 2.1
notes.content:
[u][h3][b][i]NEW FEATURES[/i][/b][/h3][/u]
[list]
[*] [i][b]INITIAL PROGRESSION SYSTEM[/b][/i]
As development continues, more of the core mechanics are being developed, one of these is the overall saving and progression system for the game. For now, this is simply a functional version that we worked on to prove that it works, but of course there will be design work that goes into it for it's final version. Even tho it's in a very primitive version right now, it's important to show you that we are working on the game, as well as give some number to grind, while we don't have much more content in the game.
[list]
[*] [i][b]Hub Area[/b][/i]
Right now this will be pretty empty, but you will see an area before getting into the dungeon, this is where progression systems, NPCs, and other out of run mechanics will exist.
[*] [b][i]Character improvement[/i][/b]
For now, check out the temporary shady individual in the hub that can boost your damage, as long as you  have some resources to trade.
[list]
[*] Killing enemies now gives you resources that can be used to upgrade your character
[/list][/list]
[*] [i][b]PAUSE[/b][/i]
The Wizards of time have bestowed their blessings, and thus you can now stop time when surrounded by foes.
[list]
[*] Added true pausing when you open the menu during a run
[/list]
[*] [i][b]FEEDBACK FOR ENEMY ATTACK[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] New indication for when an enemy is about to attack
[/list][/list]
[u][h3][b][i]BUG FIXES[/i][/b][/h3]
[/u][list]
[*] [b][i]ENEMY PATHFINDING[/i][/b]
The reason why enemies were getting stuck in corners was an oversight on how their movement was controlled, this has been fixed, and now they can use proper pathfinding to go around corners and reach you.
[list]
[*] Enemies no longer get stuck behind objects when trying to reach you
[/list]
[*] [b][i]DASH COOLDOWN[/i][/b]
The player's dash was always supposed to have a cooldown, but for some mysterious reason it didn't. It has been solved. [b][i] ~ "This was definitely not due to a line of code that had been commented"[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] Player dash now has a cooldown
[/list][/list]
[u][h3][b][i]VISUAL UPDATES[/i][/b][/h3][/u]
[list]
[*] [b][i]BETTER SCENE TRANSITIONS[/i][/b]
Simple but tasteful update to the scene transitions to present a more smooth experience in between areas.
[list]
[*] Added smooth transitions between scenes
[/list][/list]

notes.title: First Official Build - Early Access 2.0
notes.content:
[b][i]NEW FEATURES[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] Introducing a new, ranged, enemy
[*] Introducing a new spell effect on a couple of spells, Knockback
[/list]

[b][i]BUG FIXES[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed rooms that could not be exited from
[*] Added the Credits menu
[*] Aim indicator does not move with player rotation anymore
[*] Spell slots UI now properly displays primary and secondary spells that are equipped
[/list]

[b][i]BALANCE CHANGES[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] Water spells damage have been reduced, they now have knockback effect. Also some hitbox changes
[*] Coup de Burst now has a bigger hitbox and knockback
[/list]

[b][i]VISUAL UPDATES[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] New element selection cards
[*] Improved spell icons
[*] Wall of fire redesign
[*] Now there is a visual representation that when enemies catch on fire
[*] Improved design of Initial, End and Power Up rooms
[*] More polished death screen
[*] Removed some clutter from the settings menu
[/list]
